##### Project general facts

Rosemont Residences is a thoughtfully designed residential building with a distinct architectural character, set within a family-oriented community. The development offers a selection of well-planned apartments, where comfort, elegance, and practicality come together in a harmonious living environment. Its contemporary design blends seamlessly with the surroundings, creating a მშვიდ and welcoming atmosphere ideal for modern urban living.

The project features a range of amenities designed to support a balanced and active lifestyle. Residents can enjoy inviting communal spaces that encourage relaxation, social interaction, and everyday convenience, making it an ideal choice for families and individuals alike. Every aspect of the development is carefully considered to enhance comfort and create a strong sense of community.

The interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials, creating stylish and functional living spaces. Open layouts are complemented by natural light and refined detailing, offering a comfortable and elegant ambiance. The kitchens are equipped with essential appliances, while the apartments are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Triangle is a distinctive family-friendly community surrounded by lush landscaped communal areas and parks. It is home to several mixes of villas, townhouses, and apartments with a thoughtful selection of entertainment and leisure options ideal for families.  
Located in District 2 of Jumeirah Village Triangle Rosemont Residences is close to Dubai Marina, community parks, and international schools, yet away from the hustle and bustle of the city.

Residents of Jumeirah Village Triangle enjoy access to a wide array of entertainment and leisure facilities strategically located within the community. These amenities are thoughtfully designed to meet the needs of families, providing opportunities for recreation, relaxation, and socialization.

Situated in District 2 of Jumeirah Village Triangle, Rosemont Residences offers a prime location that combines accessibility with tranquility. Its proximity to Dubai Marina, community parks, and international schools ensures convenience for residents while providing a serene retreat away from the bustling city center. Rosemont Residences embodies the essence of modern living, offering residents a harmonious blend of urban convenience and suburban tranquility.
